Festival News November 19, 2026

December 2026 Raves & NYE Festivals: Every Big US Event Left This Year

By PLURGASM @plurgasm ⏱ 7 min read

2026 is not done yet. There is still a trance weekend in Long Beach, a bass festival in Las Vegas over Christmas weekend, and then the biggest run of the winter: eight multi-day New Year's Eve festivals across seven states from December 30 to January 1. Here is every big US rave left this year, with dates, lineups and which one fits your sound.

Last Call for November

Dreamstate SoCal: November 20–21, Long Beach

Insomniac's trance festival takes over the Queen Mary Waterfront this weekend. The headline moment is Above & Beyond's Anjunabeats Classics set[1]. If trance is your thing, this is the last big one of the year.

Christmas Weekend

Jackpot Festival: December 26–27, Las Vegas

Jackpot is the bridge between Christmas and NYE, and it has a new home this year. The Downtown Las Vegas Events Center closed, so the festival moves to The Llama Lot near 9th and Fremont, a former Life Is Beautiful site[2]. The bill is heavy on bass: GRiZ, Ganja White Night, Crankdat and Levity, with ALLEYCVT and Whethan as special guests[3].

NYE Festivals, Coast to Coast

Most NYE festivals now run two nights. Six of the eight below go December 30 and 31. Countdown and Proper go December 31 into New Year's Day.

Decadence Colorado: December 30–31, Denver

Global Dance and AEG Presents Rocky Mountains bring Decadence back to the Colorado Convention Center. It has one of the most mainstage-heavy lineups of the NYE run: Alesso, DJ Snake, Marshmello, Excision, GRiZ, Seven Lions, Zeds Dead and Lane 8[4]. It is fully indoors, which matters in Denver in December.

Decadence Arizona: December 30–31, Phoenix Raceway

Relentless Beats' Arizona edition leans toward house and techno this year. Chris Lake, Eli Brown, I Hate Models, Patrick Topping and Polo & Pan share the bill with SLANDER, Zomboy, Levity and ISOxo. Disclosure plays a DJ set for the midnight countdown[5].

Lights All Night: December 30–31, Dallas

Texas's long-running NYE festival returns to Fair Park. Tiësto and Gryffin lead December 30, and Chris Lake and Subtronics lead New Year's Eve[6]. Single-day passes are available if you only want one night.

HiJinx: December 30–31, Philadelphia

A bass-heavy NYE party, indoors at the Pennsylvania Convention Center. Subtronics, Tape B, Excision b2b Wooli, Ray Volpe and Sullivan King, DJ Diesel and Dabin are on the bill[7]. If you are in the Northeast and love bass, this is the one.

Eternal NYE: December 30–31, Orlando

Sacred Hive and Primal Presents bring Eternal back to the Orlando Amphitheater. Zeds Dead, RL Grime, KNOCK2 and LSDREAM headline. EDM Identity reports this will be Zeds Dead's final set of the year before an indefinite hiatus[8], so expect this one to be emotional. It is also Orlando's second big festival weekend in two months, after EDC Orlando.

To The Future: December 30–31, Nashville

BLNK CNVS's NYE rave at The Warehouse at Nashville Fairgrounds has GRiZ and Tape B on top, with TroyBoi, Kompany and more[9]. Ticket listings show it as 21+[10].

Countdown NYE: December 31 – January 1, San Bernardino

Insomniac's NYE festival is two days for the first time, back at the NOS Event Center[11]. The 75+ artist lineup is led by Alesso, DJ Snake, Marshmello, Subtronics, Tchami, DJ Diesel and S.Y.N, the trio of Svdden Death, YVM3 and NIMDA, across five stages[12].

Proper NYE / NYD: December 31 – January 1, San Diego

FNGRS CRSSD's house and techno celebration at Petco Park. The headline draw is a b3b from Cloonee, KETTAMA and Josh Baker, plus a Lane 8 This Never Happened takeover, Green Velvet and Sara Landry[13]. It is 21+[14].

Not a festival, but worth knowing

ILLENIUM plays two nights at Bill Graham Civic Auditorium in San Francisco on December 30 and 31, and New Year's Eve was already listed as sold out in October[14].

Which NYE Fits Your Sound?

  • Bass and dubstep: HiJinx, Eternal NYE, To The Future, or Jackpot the weekend before. Not sure what you are into? Our bass artist genre directory breaks down who plays what.
  • House and techno: Proper NYE / NYD or Decadence Arizona.
  • Big mainstage names: Countdown NYE, Decadence Colorado or Lights All Night.
  • GRiZ fans: he is on three end-of-year bills: Jackpot, Decadence Colorado and To The Future.

NYE Rave Tips

  • Book your ride home now. Rideshare prices spike after midnight on New Year's. Plan a pickup spot or a pre-booked ride before you go in.
  • Check indoor vs. outdoor. Decadence Colorado and HiJinx are inside convention centers. Decadence Arizona, Proper and Jackpot are outdoors, and desert nights in Phoenix and Vegas get cold. Bring a layer you can check or tie around your waist.
  • Check the age limit. Proper and To The Future are 21+. Confirm the age rules on each festival's ticket page before you buy.
  • Go in with a plan. Pick a meetup spot, charge your phone, and set the festival's map as your lock screen. Our safety page has more.
